title.en: Elections and anti-defection: assertion and reason

en.assertion: The voting age in India is 18 years.
en.reason: The 61st Amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18.
en.why: Both are true. The 61st Amendment changed Article 326, so R explains A.

hi.assertion: भारत में मतदान की आयु 18 वर्ष है।

en.assertion: A split by one-third of a party's legislators no longer protects them from disqualification.
en.reason: The Tenth Schedule was added by the 91st Amendment.
en.why: A is true: the 91st Amendment of 2003 removed the split exception. R is false: the Tenth Schedule was added by the 52nd Amendment of 1985.

hi.assertion: किसी दल के एक-तिहाई विधायकों का विभाजन अब उन्हें अयोग्यता से नहीं बचाता।
hi.reason: दसवीं अनुसूची 91वें संशोधन से जोड़ी गई।
hi.why: A सही है: 2003 के 91वें संशोधन ने विभाजन वाला अपवाद हटा दिया। R गलत है: दसवीं अनुसूची 1985 के 52वें संशोधन से जोड़ी गई।

en.assertion: A merger of a party with another is allowed under the Tenth Schedule if two-thirds of its legislators agree.
en.reason: The Presiding Officer decides questions of disqualification under the Tenth Schedule.
en.why: Both are true, but R is about who decides, not about why mergers are allowed. So R does not explain A.

hi.assertion: दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत किसी दल का दूसरे दल में विलय तब मान्य है जब उसके दो-तिहाई विधायक सहमत हों।

en.assertion: The Election Commission conducts elections to panchayats and municipalities.
en.reason: Article 324 vests the superintendence of elections to Parliament, state legislatures and the offices of President and Vice-President in the Election Commission.
en.why: A is false: State Election Commissions run local body elections. R is true and shows why: Article 324 covers only those higher elections.

hi.assertion: निर्वाचन आयोग पंचायतों और नगरपालिकाओं के चुनाव कराता है।

en.assertion: A nominated member of a House is disqualified if they join a political party more than six months after taking their seat.
en.reason: The Tenth Schedule gives a nominated member six months to join a party.
en.why: Both are true, and R is the rule that produces A.
